alt_text: Parchment map, 21 August 1831, nations and empires, framed on The South, titled "Slave revolts and conspiracies, 1800 to 1831". Marked places: Gabriel's conspiracy (1800), German Coast uprising (1811), Vesey conspiracy (1822) and Nat Turner's rebellion (1831). Rivers named: Mississippi.
